_readme: Put this object in the workerdeck field of box.json or box.local.json. The field IS the switch:
a non-null value with at least one profile boots the agent surface, null disables it.
Keys beginning with _ are ignored. See docs/SERVER.md for the full reference.
One profile per person PER ENGINE. `home` is the engine's CONFIG DIR (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for
claude, CODEX_HOME for codex), never the home directory above it - pointing it one level up
is silent and every session then runs with the wrong settings, memory, skills and credentials.
A declared profile whose `home` does not exist yet is named at boot and skipped, so one
teammate who has not logged in is never an outage for the others.
`person` is usually a users.id, and is what the agentProfiles map in box.json maps a user onto.
It is deliberately not the same field as `name`: alice:claude and alice:codex are one human,
and the per-person lookups (CLAUDE_TOKEN_<PERSON>, mcpTokensPath) key on it.

_comment: A SERVICE ACCOUNT, deliberately not a teammate: the identity the chat agent runs under,
on its own subscription, with its own CODEX_HOME. Add this when you install the `chat`
feature. Pinned read-only where teammates get acceptEdits, because nobody is watching it.
profiles.name: assistant:codex

_cwdRoots: Directories a session may be rooted at. Defaults to the checkout this server runs from.
_stateDir: Where parked session records live. Defaults to data/agent.
_claudeTokens: Set true if box.local.json workerdeckTokens carries CLAUDE_TOKEN_<PERSON>; the boot log then says who is missing one.
